notes: Hardens canonical firearm migration against legacy blank dnd5e item identifiers.
Compares persisted source identifiers instead of only prepared system values, so HMG, MA70, and any similar legacy firearm are repaired before later system updates.
Uses Foundry fallback handling only while repairing an invalid persisted firearm identifier.
Weapon runtime remains observer-only; no manufacturer automation or gameplay rule changes are added.
